documents.title: Digitization Cost Tool (canonical source)
documents.description: The complete single-file application: UI, three-scenario cost model, rate table, configuration, and signed-report generator. ~1,450 lines, no dependencies.

documents.title: BU Digitization Cost Tool (descriptively-named copy)
documents.description: Identical tool under a descriptive filename for local/USB/share-drive use. index.html is the web-server-ready name.

documents.title: User Guide
documents.description: End-user walkthrough: opening the tool, entering a records profile, reading the results and staffing sensitivity, generating the report, and keeping rates current. Mirrors the in-app Help tab.

documents.title: Technical Documentation
documents.description: Methodology, the three scenarios, calculation formulas, default unit rates and their sources (verified June 2026), a worked example, architecture, access control, and limitations. Mirrors the in-app Technical Reference.

documents.title: Deployment & Hosting Guide
documents.description: How to host the tool three ways (local file, web server, SharePoint embed), including the SharePoint JavaScript caveat. Generated by build_package.py.

documents.title: Source pricing reference (BU PDF)
documents.file: BU Digitization Cost Comparison Tool — Document Imaging & Services.pdf
documents.description: Background pricing research and the Document Imaging & Services context the rate table is built from.

documents.title: Sample records info
documents.description: Sample records-profile data used while building and demonstrating the tool.

documents.title: Distributable builder
documents.description: Generates the web-ready index.html from source, builds the Deployment Guide .docx, and zips the internal v3.1 distributable into dist/.

documents.title: Documentation generator
documents.description: Builds the User Guide, Technical Documentation, and Deployment Guide .docx files via python-docx, kept in sync with the embedded in-app guides.

documents.title: Session summary generators
documents.description: Produce dated session-summary documents for the project.

documents.description: Lightweight smoke check over the build artifacts (not a full cost-model regression suite).
